public_body: Fall River Tax Increment Finance Board
overall: The AG found the Fall River TIF Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the wheelchair-accessible meeting room and the lack of a public comment item were both permissible, and it declined to opine on the City Charter claim.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the November 26, 2018 meeting room was not wheelchair accessible because it was small with a large table and many chairs.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint does not allege, nor did our investigation reveal, that the furniture layout in an otherwise accessible room actually prevented any member of the public from attending the November 26, 2018, Board meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the meeting notice did not include a citizens input or public comment time, as the City Charter requires.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body allow public participation in its meetings

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that omitting public comment from the notice violated the City Charter.
allegations.key_passage: we offer no opinion on whether failure to allow for public participation could be a violation of the City Charter
